post.description: Deactivates the category and all its roles (they cannot be used in new requests).
Activates only the category. Its roles stay inactive until activated one by one.

schema.title: Response List Roles Api Roles Get

get.description:
Active categories with their active roles, plus the seniority levels.
Groups 1, 3 and 7 use this to get the same roleId and level codes.

get.description:
What Group 7 has: suppliers and the framework contracts they take part in, already mapped to our statuses.
`already_registered` is true if the supplier is in our pool. 502 if Group 7 cannot be reached.
